editorial.blurb: South of the Border delivers vibrant, generously portioned Tex-Mex with real care—fresh salsas, juicy grilled chicken, and a kitchen that refuses to bland things down.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the chimichanga with beef, grab a margarita (they're large and strong), and catch the Thursday special for the best value; portions easily feed two.

topDishes.note: Delicious and highly praised by regulars
